description:
As an API consumer
  I want invalid posts to receive consistent validation errors
  So that request mistakes do not become server failures

steps.name: a valid local post payload
I submit it to the local posts API
the local API creates the post with HTTP 201
the created post fields match the submitted payload

elements.name: A title at the 200-character limit is accepted

steps.name: a valid local post payload whose title is exactly 200 characters
I submit it to the local posts API
the local API creates the post with HTTP 201
the created post fields match the submitted payload

elements.name: A title longer than 200 characters is rejected

steps.name: a local post payload whose title is 201 characters long
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "title" containing "at most 200 characters"

elements.name: A title containing an unsupported symbol is rejected

steps.name: a local post payload whose title contains an unsupported symbol
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "title" containing "unsupported characters"

elements.name: A post without userId is rejected

steps.name: a local post payload with userId omitted
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "userId" containing "userId is required"

elements.name: A post without title is rejected

steps.name: a local post payload with title omitted
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "title" containing "title is required"

elements.name: A post without body is rejected

steps.name: a local post payload with body omitted
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "body" containing "body is required"
a local post payload with a string userId
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "userId" containing "positive integer"
a local post payload with a numeric title
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON validation error for "title" containing "non-empty string"

elements.name: Malformed JSON receives a JSON client error

steps.name: a malformed JSON request body
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 400 JSON error with code "INVALID_JSON" and message "Request body must be valid JSON."

elements.name: A JSON body larger than 32 KB receives a JSON client error

steps.name: a local post payload whose body exceeds the request size limit
I submit it to the local posts API
the response is an HTTP 413 JSON error with code "PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE" and message "Request body exceeds the 32 KB limit."

name: Local POST /api/posts validation
